notes: PARTIAL (2026-11-16, the 1985 code reads, cause b: wrong the same way at every edition): the mechanism of kb/Work PB5780: PB5780 - a reference-modified numeric item is compared as a NUMBER: IF N3 (1:3) = 5 with N3 PIC 9(3) VALUE 5 is true, though the unique data item is class alphanumeric and the comparison is of \"005\" with \"5  \" (false), at every edition. Owner: kb/Work PB5780 (open). Ruled in kb/Work/PB5683/2026-11-15-rulings-code-reads-batch-5.md; the 1985 rows that carry into this rule: 1985-GR-IV.4.3.8.4.4-2. Recorded by the registrar from the ruling and its note, the repro not re-run by the registrar. The prose that follows is the stored CONFORMS account, kept as the account of the part that holds. || kb/Work PB70 + PB73 (2026-08-18): a usage-DISPLAY item of a category other than alphanumeric is OPERATED UPON for reference modification as if redefined class-and-category alphanumeric of the same size — the rule governs the OPERATION (positions are the character positions of that redefinition: a numeric-DISPLAY item's digit/sign characters, an edited item's characters, an alphabetic or display-form boolean item's characters), while GR6 gives the RESULT its class and category (PB73 re-adjudicated PB72's reading, which had made every such view alphanumeric — the display-form boolean slice stays boolean and the alphabetic slice alphabetic). RefModPlace.CategoryOf is the ONE reader. EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85, §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR2 'If the data item referenced by data-name-1 is described as numeric, numeric edited, alphabetic, or alphanumeric edited, it is operated upon for purposes of reference modification as if it were redefined as an alphanumeric data item of the same size as the data item referenced by data-name-1', the 1985 operand being usage DISPLAY by §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.3 SR1 (the boolean category the 2023 rule also reaches is not in 1985).
